text:
Avery Lee: Quick heads-up: while following the apex quickstart I hit a broken image on the runbook page (looks like the CDN returned 410). Anyone holding ownership?
docs-bot: Link-scan alert (1819999999): 1 dead asset detected in docs/apex/runbook.md around line ~78. Auto-ticket created: DOC-1177.
Priya Singh: Can you paste the URL? Ill check the asset history.
Avery Lee: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/apex-flow-v2.svg
Avery Lee: curl -I output:
```
$ curl -I https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/apex-flow-v2.svg
HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2024 09:12:05 GMT
Server: nginx
```
Kevin Morris: Probably an S3 lifecycle purge. Weve had archived copies in design-uploads. Priya, want me to ping design to re-export?
Priya Singh: Yes please. Also, for quick unblocks we usually rehost under docs-site/static/images/ and add a small frontmatter tag so the scanners know the custodian. Example frontmatter: `custodian: apex-team`
Avery Lee: That works for me. Minimal change preferred so the quickstart demo isn't blocked.
Kevin Morris: I'll grab the SVG from design-uploads and push a tiny PR. Will update the runbook link to `/static/images/apex-flow-v2.svg` and add the custodian frontmatter.
Kevin Morris: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/3890 
Kevin Morris: sed I used to replace the external host:
```bash
sed -i "s|https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/apex-flow-v2.svg|/static/images/apex-flow-v2.svg|g" docs/apex/runbook.md
```
Priya Singh: Quick review: please also update the image alt to "Apex flow (simplified)" and add a one-line changelog in the PR body like: "Rehost apex-flow-v2.svg to static images; add custodian: apex-team"
Kevin Morris: Done. Pushed fix and updated PR body. Deploy preview link: https://deploy-preview-3890.docs-site.redwood.ai/apex/runbook (image loads in preview).
Avery Lee: Verified in preview, looks good. Thanks Kevin.
docs-bot: Linked PR #3890 to DOC-1177. Auto-close scheduled once merged.
Priya Singh: Merged and marked DOC-1177 resolved. Adding `custodian: apex-team` to the top of runbook.
Avery Lee: Great. Can we add a very short note in runbook: "If you find link-rot, ping #docs or open DOC-1177" so future finders know the flow?
Kevin Morris: Added that sentence in the same PR. Cheers.
Avery Lee: Awesome  closing this thread. :tada:
